title: AutoHebb: Self-Modifying Neural Networks that Zero-Shot Infer and Continually Learn
summary: Networks rank unseen item pairs and link previously separate rankings. Meta-learning fits fixed Hebbian parameters; weight analysis exposes task algorithms. Held-out item pairs and minimal-network comparisons test the inferred mechanisms. The first version of the paper shows zero-shot ranking and list-linking behavior in meta-learned Hebbian networks.
